title: The party, to see, him/her/me
summary: le and la also mean him and her, and me works the same way. They all go right before the verb: Je veux la voir (I want to see her), Tu peux me voir ? (Can you see me?). You also learn la fête, juste, voir, and how to play with word roots (provoquer, invoquer, révoquer).
points: la fête = the party (English 'fête'). The ê has a 'hat' accent.
le / la = it, and also him / her. me = me. They all go before the verb: Tu veux le provoquer.
me becomes m' before a vowel: Peux-tu m'inviter ?
juste = just. It goes after the first verb: Je veux juste la voir.
voir = to see (like 'view'). Unlike -er verbs, you hear the r.
in- at the start of a syllable is nasal: inviter, invoquer.
drills: I have to organise it. (la fête)
You just want to provoke him.
I just want to see her.
I want to see him later.
Je veux le voir plus tard.
Do you have to see him?
Do you want to see me?
